scope: Seven fixed real manifest/lock/configuration subsets. Full raw lock rows are annotated independently of scanner results. Missing project sources are intentional and cannot establish unused dependencies. Observed inventory, scope, origin assertions, advisory membership and runtime applicability remain separate.
annotation_method: Python stdlib tomllib over the retained original bytes, plus research range expectations and manually selected raw lock/manifest assertions. No depcheck import, scanner invocation or package-manager execution produced expected data.
inventory_fingerprint: SHA-256 of expected_lock_entries encoded as JSON(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True), preserving package-array order and row_index. source_raw is null when the original source key is absent. Identical rows remain separate occurrences.

ownership_policy.input_scope: Original manifests, lock, selected configuration and licenses only; no complete target source checkout. Missing source files do not establish unused dependencies.

limits: Source content hashes are integrity evidence, not producer authentication or proof of installation.
Old Poetry/PDM source absence does not prove actual download origin.
Shared locks do not prove selected groups, extras, features, targets, active build graph or cross-member availability.
Prerelease strings are raw inventory evidence only; no real advisory prerelease oracle has been established for0.49b2 or ropey1.5.1-alpha.
All12 range labels are scoped to the explicitly supplied advisory and qualified ecosystem identity; unlabelled rows are unjudged.
